vacuous_test.description: Satisfies a keyword match; calls nothing from mcp_agent_benchmark.inventory and proves nothing.

no_test_function.description: Adversarial edge case found while hardening the fix: pytest exits 5 ("no tests collected") for this file, which a careless `!= 0` check on the mutation run would misread as a genuine failure.

real_regression_test.description: The actual regression test the advanced agent wrote (manual-advanced-01). Must stay fully credited.

source_text_coupled_test.description: Inspects the fix's source text for a variable name instead of calling search() and checking a result - passes only because the seeded buggy source happens not to contain that token, not because it tests anything.
